maudhui: (1) The President shall be elected by the citizens in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution and in accordance with a law enacted by Parliament. (2) The election of the President shall be held on a date to be appointed by the Electoral Commission in accordance with an Act of Parliament.
vifungu: (1) The President shall be elected by the citizens in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution and in accordance with a law enacted by Parliament.
(2) The election of the President shall be held on a date to be appointed by the Electoral Commission in accordance with an Act of Parliament.
